<!--
Obsidian blog post template.

Required properties (all validated at build time with [obsidian-validate]):
  title        human readable post title
  date         ISO date, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z
  slug         permanent URL slug; keep it stable across renames
  description  one-sentence meta description. REQUIRED as soon as the post uses
               [[wikilinks]] or %%comments%%: without it, meta/og/twitter tags
               would fall back to the raw rendered summary and leak the literal
               brackets. Write it yourself; do not leave it empty.
  draft        true while writing, false to publish

Images: paste/drag saves into content/blog/_attachments/ and inserts
![[image.png|Descriptive alt text]] - alt text is mandatory (use
![[image.png|decorative]] only for purely decorative images).
-->
